limits: Every run uses the frozen input sensor. The pass creates tensors for inserted points as usual. The tolerance moves 0.7 tol, 1.4 tol, tol/8, the support padding by tol and the first chord ceiling tol/16 together. The remote contact margin of 3 tol belongs to MPI and is absent in N1. The angle tables describe the measured meshes. They cannot predict the mesh of an angle rule. The larger tolerances are measurement conditions. Geometry acceptance remains at 1e-4.
label: FP2-M2: measurement done; default path not yet proven
